title: Isoperimetric-Combinatorial Bounds for Range-Controlled Matchings and Quasi-Interpolation from Scattered Data
summary: We develop a mesoscopic framework for analyzing perturbations of finite point sets. Given a reference node set $Y$ with known cubature and approximation properties, we consider a disordered node set $Q$ that is observed only through its populations in cubes at scale $r>0$. By imposing Hall-type (HT) combinatorial constraints on these populations, we prove the existence of a perfect matching between $Y$ and $Q$ with $O(r)$ range.
